nodes.name: claude.rs
nodes.summary: Detects Claude Code / Anthropic credentials on the local machine by reading shell config, Claude Code's JSON config, OAuth credential files, and the macOS keychain, then validates and enriches them with account/model metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `#[cfg(target_os)]`-gated variants of keychain readers to support macOS-only Security framework access.

nodes.name: detect_claude_keys
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that tries shell config, Claude Code's JSON config, local OAuth credentials, and the macOS keychain (in order) to find a usable Claude API key or OAuth session.

nodes.name: read_anthropic_from_shell_config
nodes.summary: Scans common shell RC files (.zshrc, .bashrc, etc.) for an exported ANTHROPIC_API_KEY value.

nodes.name: read_claude_config
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes Claude Code's local JSON config file to extract a stored API key.

nodes.name: detect_claude_code_oauth
nodes.summary: Locates and validates a Claude Code OAuth session, returning a DetectedKey enriched with account and organization metadata when the token is valid.

nodes.name: read_local_claude_credentials
nodes.summary: Reads Claude Code's local OAuth credentials JSON file from disk.

nodes.name: get_claude_credentials_paths
nodes.summary: Builds the list of candidate filesystem paths where Claude Code's credentials file might live.

nodes.name: parse_claude_oauth_credentials
nodes.summary: Parses the raw JSON contents of a Claude OAuth credentials file into a structured ClaudeAiOauthCredentials value.

nodes.name: validate_claude_code_oauth_token
nodes.summary: Confirms a Claude Code OAuth token is still valid by making a lightweight authenticated request against Anthropic's API.

nodes.name: token_is_expired
nodes.summary: Checks whether an OAuth token's expiry timestamp has passed, allowing a small clock-skew buffer.

nodes.name: fetch_claude_code_oauth_models
nodes.summary: Calls Anthropic's model listing endpoint using an OAuth bearer token to discover models available to the account.

nodes.name: parse_claude_code_oauth_models_response
nodes.summary: Parses the JSON body of the OAuth models-list response into a list of model ids.

nodes.name: fetch_claude_code_oauth_identity
nodes.summary: Fetches the Claude Code account identity (email, org) associated with an OAuth token.

nodes.name: fetch_claude_code_oauth_profile
nodes.summary: Calls Anthropic's profile endpoint with an OAuth bearer token to retrieve account and organization details.

nodes.name: parse_claude_code_oauth_profile_response
nodes.summary: Parses the JSON body of the OAuth profile response into structured account/organization data.

nodes.name: claude_code_account_metadata
nodes.summary: Builds the account_metadata map (email, org name, rate-limit tier) attached to a detected Claude Code OAuth key.

nodes.name: read_claude_keychain_credentials
nodes.summary: Reads Claude Code OAuth credentials from the macOS keychain using the Security framework via the `security` CLI.

nodes.name: get_claude_keychain_config_dirs
nodes.summary: Resolves the candidate config directories used to scope the macOS keychain lookup for Claude Code.

nodes.name: read_macos_keychain_password
nodes.summary: Shells out to the macOS `security find-generic-password` command to read a stored keychain password.

nodes.name: codex.rs
nodes.summary: Detects OpenAI Codex CLI credentials by reading Codex's auth.json (API key and OAuth tokens) and the legacy OpenAI CLI config file.

nodes.name: detect_codex_keys
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that tries Codex's auth.json (API key/OAuth) and the legacy OpenAI config file, in order, to find a usable Codex/OpenAI credential.

nodes.name: read_codex_auth_config
nodes.summary: Reads and parses Codex CLI's auth.json, extracting either an API key or OAuth access/refresh tokens.

nodes.name: validate_codex_access_token
nodes.summary: Validates a Codex OAuth access token against OpenAI's API via the CodexValidator.

nodes.name: read_openai_config
nodes.summary: Reads the legacy OpenAI CLI config file to extract a stored API key.

nodes.name: copilot.rs
nodes.summary: Detects a GitHub Copilot token by inspecting the GitHub CLI's local hosts configuration file.

nodes.name: detect_copilot_keys
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that checks the GH_TOKEN environment variable, then the GitHub CLI hosts config, to find a usable Copilot/GitHub token.

nodes.name: read_github_cli_config
nodes.summary: Reads the GitHub CLI's hosts.yml configuration file from disk.

nodes.name: extract_github_token_from_config
nodes.summary: Extracts the oauth_token value for github.com from the GitHub CLI hosts config contents.

nodes.name: cursor.rs
nodes.summary: Detects Cursor IDE session tokens by reading Cursor's local SQLite state database and decoding the embedded JWT to derive the user id, then fetches usage quota.

nodes.name: detect_cursor_keys
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that reads Cursor IDE's local state database for a session token, decodes the embedded user id, and fetches quota.

nodes.name: get_cursor_state_db_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the platform-specific filesystem path to Cursor IDE's SQLite state database.

nodes.name: read_cursor_tokens_from_db
nodes.summary: Opens Cursor's SQLite state database and reads the stored access/refresh tokens.

nodes.name: extract_user_id_from_jwt
nodes.summary: Decodes the payload segment of a JWT to extract the embedded Cursor user id without verifying the signature.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Shared helpers for the auto-detect module: resolves config file paths per provider, extracts shell export values, builds DetectedKey records, and dispatches provider-specific key validation.

nodes.name: get_home_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves the current user's home directory, returning an error string if it cannot be determined.

nodes.name: get_claude_config_paths
nodes.summary: Returns the list of candidate paths for Claude's shell/config files to scan during detection.

nodes.name: get_openai_config_paths
nodes.summary: Returns the list of candidate paths for OpenAI/Codex config files to scan during detection.

nodes.name: extract_export_value
nodes.summary: Parses shell config file contents to find an `export VAR=value` assignment for a given variable name.

nodes.name: create_detected_key
nodes.summary: Builds a standard DetectedKey record from a raw key value, provider, and source description.

nodes.name: validate_anthropic_key
nodes.summary: Validates a candidate Anthropic API key using the AnthropicValidator.

nodes.name: validate_openai_key
nodes.summary: Validates a candidate OpenAI API key using the OpenAIValidator.

nodes.name: validate_github_token
nodes.summary: Validates a candidate GitHub/Copilot token using the CopilotValidator.

nodes.name: ClaudeConfig
nodes.summary: Deserialization shape for Claude Code's local JSON config file's api_key field.

nodes.name: OpenAIConfig
nodes.summary: Deserialization shape for the legacy OpenAI CLI config file's api_key field.

nodes.name: kiro.rs
nodes.summary: Detects a local Kiro CLI token by delegating to the kiro provider's model-listing endpoint to confirm the token works.

nodes.name: detect_kiro_keys
nodes.summary: Reads a local Kiro CLI token and confirms it works by calling the Kiro model-listing endpoint, returning a DetectedKey on success.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates auto-detection across all supported CLI agents (Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode), aggregating results into a single AutoDetectResult for the frontend.

nodes.name: auto_detect_key
nodes.summary: Runs auto-detection across every supported CLI (Cursor, Claude, Codex, Copilot, Kiro, OpenCode) for the requested agent type and returns the first match plus diagnostic messages when nothing is found.

nodes.name: DetectedKey
nodes.summary: Represents a single credential discovered by auto-detection, including its value, provider, source description, and optional account/quota metadata.

nodes.name: QuotaInfo
nodes.summary: Represents usage-quota information (limits, remaining) discovered alongside a detected key.

nodes.name: AutoDetectResult
nodes.summary: Aggregate result returned to the frontend after auto-detection, containing all detected keys and diagnostic messages.

nodes.name: opencode.rs
nodes.summary: Detects OpenCode CLI credentials by parsing its auth.json, mapping known provider entries (including the OpenCode Go/Zhipu variant) to DetectedKey records.

nodes.name: detect_opencode_keys
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that reads OpenCode's auth.json and maps recognized provider entries (including OpenCode Go) into DetectedKey records.

nodes.name: read_opencode_auth_config
nodes.summary: Reads and parses OpenCode CLI's auth.json into a map of provider name to auth entry.

nodes.name: batch.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command that bulk-validates every stored key against its provider, reading an optional keys export file and running validation concurrently in a blocking task.

nodes.name: validate_keys_from_file
nodes.summary: Tauri command that loads every stored key (optionally supplemented by an imported keys export file), validates each one concurrently, and returns a per-key validation summary.

nodes.name: KeyValidationSummary
nodes.summary: Per-key result summary (valid/invalid, message) returned from a bulk key-validation run.

nodes.name: cli_version.rs
nodes.summary: Scans the locally installed version of a CLI agent and probes the latest available version from npm, GitHub releases, or a JSON manifest, caching results and computing outdated/current status.

nodes.name: source_for
nodes.summary: Determines which upstream version source (npm, GitHub release, JSON manifest, etc.) should be probed for a given CLI agent.

nodes.name: scan_cli_version
nodes.summary: Tauri command that scans the installed version of a CLI agent, probes the latest published version, compares them, and returns/caches a CliVersionSnapshot.
